Description Welcome to 'A Shore Bett,'  your ideal Seagrove Beach escape! This charming 3-bed, 3-bath home offers the prefect mix of comfort and coastal adventure. Enjoy multiple outdoor seating areas, perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails, and take advantage of the private pool for ultimate relaxation. With a golf cart and 6 adult bikes included, exploring 30A's stunning beaches, shops, and restaurants is effortless! Whether you're unwinding in the sunshine or setting out for a day of adventure, A Shore Bett guarantees a vacation to remember. **Pet Friendly (2 Dogs- $250/dog) ACCOMMODATIONS A Shore Bett comfortably accommodates up to 10 people: Bedroom 1: (1) Twin/Full Bunk, (1) Twin/Twin Bunk, Shared Bath Bedroom 2: 1 King, Shared Bath Bedroom 3: 1 King,1 Full Sleeper Sofa, 1 Twin/Twin Bunk, Private Bath FEATURES 6-Seater Golf Cart 6 Adult Bikes Pet Friendly (2 Dogs Max, $250/dog fee) Private Pool - Heated upon request **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Fully Stocked Kitchen Full Washer & Dryer Large 2nd Floor Balcony Covered Outdoor Patio Smart TVs Beach Gear BEACH ACCESS Three access points, just a short walk from the home: 1. One Seagrove Place: One Seagrove Access is on Seagrove Place about 100 yards south of Scenic 30A across from Robert Ellis Street and has a shower and no parking. The access is across Scenic 30A from Cassine Gardens subdivision and next to One Seagrove Place Condominiums, one of only two high rises on Scenic 30A. 2. Santa Clara: Santa Clara beach access is located near Bramble Grove Road, about 3.5 miles to the west of Prominence. This beach has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. For your convenience beach chairs, umbrellas, and kayaks are available to rent from beach services. 3. Beachwood Villas: Beachwood Villas Access is on Scenic 30A across from Beachwood Villas, Somerset Bridge Road, and the Tom Thumb in Seagrove Beach, Florida. There is a bike rack but no car parking, and the access has a shower and quite a long boardwalk to the high bluff overlooking the gulf. **Should you desire to have beach chair service (chairs and umbrellas set-up), the company that provides these amenities is Big Fish Bike & Beach Rental. During busy summer months, it's best to rent your chairs and umbrellas in advance. When making reservations online (or over the phone), you would choose "Seagrove Dunes" as the location. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING This home includes 2 parking space on the driveway with NO overflow parking available. No RV or trailer parking in the driveway. ABOUT THE AREA Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community that is on 30a, nestled between Seaside and Watersound. Seagrove is perfect for nature lovers seeking an unspoiled retreat and uncrowded environment. Enjoy canoeing, kayaking, swimming and more in this quaint town with Old Florida charm. You will find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire party s needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach and want a different experience. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *Up to 2 dogs allowed. Pet fee of $250/dog applies. Host must be notified of pet prior to arrival. 2 Dogs Max! *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a .
